description: MCP server for StallRow — the x402 utility row: wallet tools, verdicts, Pre-Trade Guard, Verdict Index, packs (USDC on Base)
name: io.github.QuincyGB/stall-row-mcp

environmentVariables.description: EVM private key (0x...) of a wallet holding USDC on Base. Used locally to sign the x402 EIP-3009 authorization. For paid calls.
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing that key (alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY).
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Optional global spend-guard ceiling per call in USDC micro-units. Default: each route's known price is its own guard. The client refuses to sign anything priced above the guard.
environmentVariables.name: STALL_ROW_MAX_AMOUNT_UNITS

title: StallRow
